title: feature meta.yml
description: Contract for every specs/features/<ID>/meta.yml. STRUCTURAL only — enum values (domain/status/repo) are validated by `specs.mjs check` against spec.config.json, NOT hard-coded here. A feature is a living capability, not a task.

id.description: == folder name. [DOMAIN]-<slug>. Identifies a CAPABILITY, not a task. No ticket key in the ID.

domain.description: From spec.config.json.domains (if that list is non-empty). The feature ID must start with it.

origin.description: WHO created this feature. 'reverse-engineered' = written directly by reverse-spec from existing production code. 'folded' = created when an Add-change shipped (archive). 'spec-first' = legacy/manual. These are the only legitimate writers of features/.

acceptance_stage.description: Test-suite maturity: one of spec.config.json.acceptance_stages (e.g. happy|full). Orthogonal to `status`. `check` warns if a shipped feature is still 'happy'.

confidence.description: Mostly for reverse-engineered specs — how much to trust it.

jira_url.description: Link to the main/epic ticket, or null.

history.description: Change log, NEWEST FIRST. One line per change that created/altered this capability: 'YYYY-MM-DD · TICKET · what changed'. spec.md holds the CURRENT state; this is the audit trail. `archive` prepends here on fold.

design.description: UI/UX design link (e.g. Figma URL), or null if a local ui file is used instead.

ui.description: Path (relative to this folder) to a local design file the AI can read, e.g. 'ui.html'.

depends_on.description: Other feature IDs this capability relies on.

pending_changes.description: Open changes in flight that target this feature but have NOT shipped. Each points at a change folder, e.g. 'OPCS-142 · changes/Modify-OPCS-142-… · summary'. spec.md still describes the CURRENT state; a change folds in only on archive.

related_code.description: '<repo>:<path-or-glob>' — repo keys from spec.config.json.repos (if that list is non-empty).
